t: Free teacher guides from AI4K12 for demos on speech, faces, chatbots, and images.
steps: Find the AI4K12 Activity Resource Guides page.
Choose a guide that fits your grade band and Big Idea.
Open the linked demo site and test it on a student device.
Check whether the demo asks for a camera or microphone.
Open any Scratch files from Google Drive and check that the school allows access.
Run the demo with the class and follow the guide.
